title: Seede Yiite
intro: Neɗɗo luggiɗiiɗo, baawɗo udditaade goonga timmuɗo, naati e yahdu yiytude ruuhu. Goongɗingol maɓɓe ngol ustataako addani ɓe luulndaade kuule tabitinaaɗe, ɓe njogori haɓtaade jarribooji mawɗi jarriborɗi keeri iimanaagal. Ooɗoo daartol ruuhu ko seedantaagal ndeenka e ardaade Alla.
clues: Mi barkiniraama tiitoonde keeriinde ummoraade e Joomiraawo am, maande jokkondiral luggiɗngal e teeŋtungal.
Nguurndam am gadanal ngal, ko e nder leñol ngol sujji e nate peewnaaɗe, kono ɓernde am ina yiɗi Alla gooto Goonga oo.
Miɗo ndaara tagopeeje asamaan ɗee, naange, lewru e koode, miɗo miijoo ummoraade e njiimaandi mum en, miɗo sikki ɗe mbaawataa wonde Joomiraawo am.
E nder golle ƴaañgal e musyrik yaajɗo, mi fotndii e laamɓe fenaande, mi acci heen gooto, ɓurɗo mawnude, mo alaa ko bonnata, hono tuumaaɗo deƴƴuɗo.
Caɗeele am e rewde sanamuuji ngaddi mi jukkungo tiiɗngo, nde tawnoo mi ñaawaama yo mi werlee e jeyngol ɓuuɓngol.
Kono, e yamiroore Tagɗo am, ɓuuɓol tiiɗngol ngol wayliima wonti ɓuuɓol e kisal, ina reena nguurndam am.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
